facts.text: I want to support a friend or family member who is struggling with addiction.
It is tough for me to see someone I love struggle with addiction.
It has been really rough for me and my family.
My family and I have been trying to be supportive of a loved one with addiction.
It seems like nothing we do is making a difference for my family.
It is frustrating for me that our support does not seem to help.
It is tough for me to see my loved one struggle despite our efforts.
I and my family will not give up on my loved one.
It is hard for me to know what else we can do to help.
It has been really hard for me to watch my loved one go through addiction.
I appreciate the advice I received about supporting someone with addiction.
It helps me to know that we are not alone in this struggle.
It is hard for me to see them suffer and not know how to help.
I will keep the suggestions in mind and keep supporting them.

keyphrases: supporting a friend or family member
